catalog.method: GET fixed URL; strip spaces/newlines; Base64 -> modified XXTEA (delta 0x9E5729B1, key Princie!) -> JSON UTF-8
catalog.notes: Remote file name (FEBRUARY) appears to rotate monthly; if the vendor changes it, the script URL must change too. No own URI scheme; no text decoder delivered.

files.method: hex -> repeated XOR with 12-byte key -> JNI modified UTF-8 -> JSON; protections checked after decryption
files.notes: Key verified by disassembly of Handsome's own libputils.so (split config arm64, .rodata 0xc4f68; identical to the HX/TRM family key). No real .hsome from a phone yet. assets/server.psi is a Psiphon server list, not a catalog or .hsome file.
